== Biography ==
Marion Glasgow was born by 9 June 1751 and baptised that day at Kirknewton and East Calder, daughter of James Glasgow and Katharine Rule. The transcript gives Kirknewton residence and records her as female.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686207987&tab=this Findmypast fmp-record-r-686207987], inspected derivative transcript,25October2026; original register uninspected.</ref>
